mission: Complete Test Suite Recovery to 100% and Implement Autonomous Completion Protocol

tasks.title: Identify all ~20 remaining test failures
tasks.description: Run test suite sequentially with -x flag to identify first failure, document it, repeat until all ~20 failures cataloged. Create detailed inventory with test names, error messages, and root causes.
acceptance_criteria: Complete list of all remaining failing tests
Root cause identified for each failure (schema mismatch, missing fixtures, etc.)

tasks.title: Fix all remaining schema-related test failures
tasks.description: Update test fixtures for remaining ~20 schema failures. Apply same methodology from test_accuracy_dashboard fix: read model schemas, update ALL test fixtures to match current Pydantic models from Leap 4.
acceptance_criteria: Test fixtures match current Pydantic model schemas

tasks.title: Verify schema fixes pass all tests
tasks.description: Run test suite to verify all schema fixes work correctly. Ensure 100% pass rate achieved.
acceptance_criteria: All previously failing tests now pass

tasks.title: Binary search to identify hanging test
tasks.description: Test suite times out at 10 minutes (expected: 5-8 minutes). Use binary search to isolate hanging test: run first half, then second half, repeat until single test identified. Document exact test causing timeout.
acceptance_criteria: Test name, file path, and behavior documented
Root cause hypothesis formed (infinite loop, blocking I/O, resource leak)

tasks.title: Fix or quarantine hanging test
tasks.description: Fix identified hanging test by adding timeout decorators, fixing blocking I/O, or cleaning up resources. If unfixable, quarantine with @pytest.mark.skip and detailed documentation.
acceptance_criteria: No timeout during full suite run

tasks.title: Execute 3-run stability validation
tasks.description: Run full test suite 3 consecutive times to verify stability. Document: (1) Pass rate, (2) Execution time, (3) Flaky tests (if any), (4) Performance metrics. Confirm 100% pass rate and zero crashes.
acceptance_criteria: Zero flaky tests (consistent results across runs)

tasks.title: Update ADR-031 status to COMPLETE
tasks.description: Update ADR-031 status from IN PROGRESS to COMPLETE. Add final metrics: 100% pass rate, total execution time, remaining work section removed, success criteria met. Document achievement of constitutional Article II compliance.
acceptance_criteria: Final metrics documented (100% pass rate, execution time)
Constitutional compliance verified (Article II fully satisfied)

tasks.title: Declare Article II full compliance
tasks.description: Update ARTICLE_II_COMPLIANCE_REPORT.md to reflect FULL COMPLIANCE status. Change from PARTIAL (90%+) to COMPLETE (100%). Document validation evidence and constitutional satisfaction.
acceptance_criteria: Article II compliance status: FULL COMPLIANCE
Gap analysis section removed (zero gaps remaining)

tasks.title: Analyze why orchestrator concluded at 90%
tasks.description: Investigate why PrimeA orchestrator declared mission complete at 90% with 40% context remaining. Identify decision point in execution protocol where early termination occurred. Document root cause: (1) Missing completion criteria check, (2) Premature report generation, (3) Insufficient validation gate.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause identified (specific code location or logic flaw)

tasks.title: Design autonomous completion validator
tasks.description: Design validation gate that prevents premature mission conclusion. Requirements: (1) Check all task acceptance criteria met 100%, (2) Verify constitutional compliance (Articles I-V), (3) Confirm zero remaining work documented, (4) Validate context usage efficiency (warn if <80% used but work incomplete).
acceptance_criteria: All edge cases covered (partial completion, timeout, errors)
Integration points identified (STEP 7 in execution protocol)

tasks.title: Implement autonomous completion validator
tasks.description: Implement validation gate in PrimeA execution protocol. Add check before STEP 7 (Generate Execution Report) that validates: (1) All tasks completed (not just attempted), (2) All acceptance criteria met, (3) Constitutional compliance achieved, (4) Zero TODO items in remaining work. Block report generation if validation fails.
acceptance_criteria: Validator integrated into execution protocol (before STEP 7)
All validation checks implemented and tested
Clear error messages when validation fails
Execution continues until 100% complete or explicit failure

tasks.title: Test completion validator with edge cases
tasks.description: Create comprehensive test suite for completion validator. Test scenarios: (1) All tasks complete → validator passes, (2) One task incomplete → validator blocks, (3) Constitutional violation → validator blocks, (4) Remaining work documented → validator blocks. Ensure validator prevents premature conclusions.

tasks.title: Create ADR for autonomous completion protocol
tasks.description: Create ADR-032 documenting the autonomous completion protocol. Include: (1) Context (premature 90% conclusion), (2) Decision (validation gate implementation), (3) Consequences (zero premature conclusions), (4) Constitutional alignment (Article I: complete context), (5) Implementation details.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause analysis included (why 90% conclusion happened)
Future orchestrators will apply this pattern

tasks.title: Store completion patterns to VectorStore
tasks.description: Extract and store 3 patterns to VectorStore: (1) Autonomous completion validation (confidence 1.0), (2) Premature conclusion prevention (confidence 0.95), (3) Context usage efficiency monitoring (confidence 0.85). Tag for orchestration, quality-enforcement, and meta-intelligence categories.
acceptance_criteria: Patterns stored to VectorStore with proper tags

tasks.title: Update PrimeA documentation with completion protocol
tasks.description: Update .claude/commands/primea.md to document autonomous completion validator. Add new section in STEP 6.5 (before STEP 7) explaining validation gate, requirements, and error handling. Update execution protocol flowchart.
acceptance_criteria: PrimeA documentation updated with completion protocol

checkpoints.prompt: Verify all remaining test failures identified and fixed before proceeding to timeout resolution
Verify 100% pass rate achieved and Article II compliance before implementing prevention mechanism
